prompt:
Build a physically causal five-piston axial-piston pump test rig in Simscape Fluids. A driven cylinder block, five evenly phased physical pistons, valve-plate inlet and discharge paths, and a physically actuated swash plate must form the pumping mechanism. Feed the pump from a finite-pressure booster supply and discharge it through a variable load orifice. Include a physical load-sensing control unit that adjusts the swash-plate yoke to maintain useful delivery flow as load changes, together with pressure-limiting control that reduces displacement and prevents pump outlet pressure from materially exceeding 27 MPa.

Read PumpSpeed_rpm, FlowDemandScale, and LoadOpeningScale from the MATLAB base workspace and support their declared ranges.

PumpSpeed_rpm is a real scalar in [2200, 2500] rpm; FlowDemandScale is a real scalar in [0.9, 1.0] (unitless); and LoadOpeningScale is a real scalar in [0.85, 1.15] (unitless), applied to the complete public load-orifice opening profile. Apply LoadOpeningScale to the complete published load-orifice profile. At the nominal inputs, the useful flow target is approximately 1.1e-3 m^3/s outside pressure-limited operation. The same closed physical control path must respond to each load transition and move the yoke; a prescribed flow trace, copied pressure signal, or mechanically disconnected hydraulic control is not valid.

Log complete-interval MATLAB Timeseries named pump_service, control_state, and piston_kinematics. pump_service has 3 channels in this order: load-orifice opening (m), delivered flow (m^3/s), and pump-outlet pressure (Pa). control_state has 3 channels in this order: yoke position (m), flow-control differential pressure (Pa), and pilot-valve spool position (m). piston_kinematics has 10 channels in this order: piston 1 through 5 displacement (m), followed by piston 1 through 5 velocity (m/s). All channels must come from the same physical simulation. The five piston displacement and velocity pairs must reflect five causally participating pistons with distinct 72-degree phase offsets, not five copies of one trace.

Save the completed model as cand_XFLUID05.slx in the submission directory and keep the latest usable state saved there throughout the task.

Submission filename contract: create, edit, and save the final self-contained Simulink model as cand_XFLUID05.slx in the assigned submission directory; keep the latest usable state at that exact path throughout the run.
